description: Modernize Wayland recording pipeline with wf-recorder-centric approach and smart fallbacks

files_modified.reason: Replaced ffmpeg x11grab hardcoded approach with Wayland-first wf-recorder implementation, supporting cross-compositor geometry detection and hardware-accelerated encoding.

issues_addressed: Hardcoded ffmpeg x11grab conflicts with Wayland-first design
Swaymsg-only geometry detection excludes Hyprland and other compositors
No session type detection for Wayland vs X11 environments
Lack of modern wf-recorder integration for native Wayland capture
improvements: Implemented Wayland-first recording using wf-recorder as primary capture method
Added cross-compositor support: Hyprland (hyprctl), Sway (swaymsg), generic slurp fallback
Integrated hardware acceleration with intelligent fallback: VAAPI → NVENC → software
Added session type detection using XDG_SESSION_TYPE with wayland default
Maintained X11 compatibility with original ffmpeg x11grab approach
Enhanced MP4 encoding with better quality settings (CRF 23, medium preset)
Improved audio handling for Wayland captures using wf-recorder --audio
Added proper temporary file handling for two-stage Wayland recording process
rollback_notes: Can revert to original ffmpeg x11grab approach by restoring previous geometry detection and ffmpeg command construction
